description: This PHP class 'OA_Admin_UI_Rule_JQueryValidationRuleBuilder' generates JavaScript code for jQuery validation rules and methods based on quickform rules, including rule definitions, validation methods, and messages, for client-side form validation.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI_Rule_JQueryValidationRuleBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for building jQuery validation rules, validation methods, and messages from quickform rules for client-side validation.

methods.name: getJQueryValidationRulesScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code defining validation rules and messages for form elements based on provided rules.

methods.name: getJQueryValidationMethodsScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for custom jQuery validation methods based on provided rules.

methods.name: filterNonSupported
methods.description: Filters out rules that do not have a supported jQuery adaptor.

methods.name: getJQueryValidationRule
methods.description: Builds a jQuery validation rule for a specific rule using the adaptor map.

methods.name: getJQueryValidationMessage
methods.description: Builds a validation message for a specific rule using the adaptor map.
